Question: The function \(f\) is defined by \[f(x) = \lfloor|x|\rfloor - |\lfloor x \rfloor|\] for all real numbers \(x,\) where \(\lfloor r \rfloor\) denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to the real number \(r.\) What is the range of \(f?\)
